caption: The video captures a red commuter train stopped at an outdoor platform beneath overhead wires, with an orange LED display and signal at the left. A man in a blue jacket with grey shoulders and a dark beanie stands with his back to the camera, his right arm stretched toward the train's door. A small red light above the door becomes illuminated. Behind him, a man with a backpack waits near the same door, while pedestrians occupy the platform edge. The blue-jacketed man keeps his arm extended, then lowers it to his side. The backpacked man advances toward the door. A yellow bag appears at the door, and later a red bag appears there. The camera view stays on the train side and waiting passengers.
